title: Build a clause-complete semantic compiler and truthful readiness gates
description:
Path A of the plan's Phase 1. Replace atom-presence readiness with a
source-clause semantic IR, shared cross-kind mechanic primitives, bidirectional
provenance, in-band execution readiness, and audits rebuilt on the clause model.

Root cause this epic addresses: the pipeline is strongest at extracting records
and preserving prose, but treats a record containing ANY mechanics atom (a save,
a damage expression, a condition mention, a reset, a table link) as modeled. A
feature, spell, creature entry, or hazard therefore appears covered while its
procedure is mostly prose.

Execution order within the epic: A1 and A3 may run in parallel once stable clause
and source identities are agreed; A2 implements against A1; A4 stabilizes with
E0; A5 lands last.
acceptance_criteria:
- No record family can report complete from mechanics-atom presence.
- Captured / projected / engine-supported / discoverable are separately represented in pack data and in reports.
- Recurring mechanics are parsed once by shared primitives, not re-parsed per record kind.
- Coverage is proven in both directions (source->output and output->source) at field level.
- The bundle emits a coverage-depth matrix proving semantic — not sampled — review for every mechanics-bearing family.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
